name: fairbuild-closeout
description: Fairbuild Closeout: the closeout checklist for completed jobs against the documents and steps you require (final lien waivers, warranties, O&M manuals, as-builts, punch list, occupancy, final pay application and others you name): items missing, overdue, rejected or still open long after completion, and which jobs are ready for final billing. Drafts reminders to the project manager. Never submits a closeout package or a final invoice.
